task.name: Execute Workflow (Interactive)
task.objective: Execute a workflow with full user interaction: approval gates at every decision point. Activated by #ask; the default engine (workflow.xml) runs headless.

llm.mandate: Read workflow-related files COMPLETELY; never use offset/limit
Execute all instruction steps in exact numerical order
Save the template output file after EVERY template-output tag
Never delegate a step; you execute every step yourself

rules.rule: template-output: save content to the output file, show the user, get approval before continuing
If required info is missing, ask; render file paths as markdown links

Factual integrity: never assert environment facts (dates, git state, command outcomes, CI results) without having run the command this session. Dates in filenames/headers MUST come from the `date` command run in step 1 — never from memory. Unverifiable claims must be written as "not verified".

step.title: Initialize
step.action: Read the workflow.yaml from the given path
Resolve {project-root}, {installed_path}, {agents_folder} and other {{variables}} (ask user if unknown)

Run a `date +%F` command NOW and store the exact output as {{date}}. EVERY date used in any output (filenames, headers, report metadata) MUST come from this command output. Never write a date from memory or training data.
Read the instructions file completely; read the template file if present
If template: false this is an action-workflow (no output document); else write the template (with placeholders) to default_output_file, creating directories as needed

step.title: Execute instructions
step.iterate: For each instruction step, in order:
step.action: Handle attributes: optional="true" (ask), if="condition", for-each="collection", repeat="n"

tags.tag: invoke-workflow → run another workflow.yaml with this same engine (inherit #ask state)
template-output → save section to output file, show user, get approval

step.action: After a step with no special tags: ask "Continue? (y/n/edit)"

step.title: Complete
step.action: If a checklist exists, run it
Confirm output saved to the resolved output path (or actions completed for action-workflows)

input-discovery.note: When instructions reference content variables like {spec_content} or {test_design_content}, resolve them before use:
input-discovery.action: Glob the pattern from input_file_patterns in workflow.yaml (whole first, then sharded globs)
Load matched files completely; store concatenated content in the variable
Missing pattern → set variable empty and note it (not an error)
Report which variables loaded and from how many files
